frameOSGallery.name: FrameOS Gallery
frameOSGallery.description: Random image from the FrameOS gallery

fields.markdown: [Click here](https://gallery.frameos.net/) to see all the galleries.

fields.name: format
fields.label: Image format
fields.hint: jpg: the gallery scales the image to the area it is drawn in and sends a JPEG, a fraction of the bytes and the decoding of the original (recommended, every color kept). png: the same, lossless, about five times the bytes. original: the file as uploaded, scaled on the frame.

fields.name: fit
fields.label: Scale to the target
fields.hint: The gallery scales the image to the area it will be drawn in (the frame, or a split cell). auto follows the image node's placement; cover fills the area and crops the rest, contain keeps the whole image inside it. Neither upscales a small image.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "FrameOS Gallery",
  "description": "Random image from the FrameOS gallery",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "fields": [
    { "markdown": "[Click here](https://gallery.frameos.net/) to see all the galleries." },
    {
      "name": "category",
      "type": "select",
      "options": [
        "building-art-styles",
        "cute",
        "cyberpunk-europe",
        "low-poly-animals",
        "masterpieces",
        "space-gallery",
        "space-odyssey",
        "other"
      ],
      "value": "cute",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Category"
    },
    {
      "name": "categoryOther",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Category (if other)",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "category", "operator": "eq", "value": "other" }]
    },
    {
      "name": "format",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["jpg", "png", "original"],
      "value": "jpg",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Image format",
      "hint": "jpg: the gallery scales the image to the area it is drawn in and sends a JPEG, a fraction of the bytes and the decoding of the original (recommended, every color kept). png: the same, lossless, about five times the bytes. original: the file as uploaded, scaled on the frame."
    },
    {
      "name": "fit",
      "type": "select",
      "options": ["auto", "cover", "contain"],
      "value": "auto",
      "required": false,
      "label": "Scale to the target",
      "hint": "The gallery scales the image to the area it will be drawn in (the frame, or a split cell). auto follows the image node's placement; cover fills the area and crops the rest, contain keeps the whole image inside it. Neither upscales a small image.",
      "showIf": [{ "field": "format", "operator": "ne", "value": "original" }]
    }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }],
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "inputEnabled": true, "durationEnabled": true, "duration": "900" }
}
